title: Figure 12. Schematic of the Casimir Effect; Table 1 gravitational squeezing of vacuum ZPF
description: Color schematic of two parallel gray plates labeled "Casimir plates" with green wavy lines labeled "Vacuum fluctuations" outside and blue arrows pressing inward; caption: "Figure 12. Schematic of the Casimir Effect". The top of the page has "Table 1. Substantial Gravitational Squeezing Occurs for Vacuum ZPF When λ ≥ 8πrs", listing values for the Sun, Jupiter, Earth, a typical mountain, Planck mass and proton. Section heading: "4. Vacuum Field Stress: Negative Energy from the Casimir Effect".
